title: Recording studio
closeConfirm: Leave the studio? The take you just recorded has not been submitted and will be lost.
session: {n, plural, =0 {No take yet this session} one {# take this session} other {# takes this session}}

prompt.spontaneous: Talk about this, in your own words
prompt.conversational: Have this conversation with your partner
prompt.onePhone: One phone records, both of you are credited. Put it where both voices are heard.
prompt.talkIn: Talk about this in {language}, in your own words

phase.idle: Tap the button and wait for “Speak now”

hint.tooEarly: Keep going: at least {min, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
hint.quiet: We can barely hear you. Come a little closer or speak up.
hint.space: Tip: press Space to record and stop, Enter to submit.

review.title: Listen back
review.restored: We kept the take you recorded before the app closed. Listen to it, then submit it or record again.

problem.title: Let's try that again
problem.silent: No sound reached the app. Check the microphone is not covered or muted, then speak clearly.
problem.too_short: Too short: please speak for at least {min, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
problem.too_long: Too long: please keep it under {max, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
problem.too_quiet: A bit too quiet. Hold the phone closer to your mouth and speak up.
problem.clipped: Too loud, the sound is distorted. Hold the phone a little further away.
problem.silence: Leave a short silence before and after you speak: wait for “Speak now”, and stay silent a moment after you finish.
problem.noisy: Too much background noise: your voice does not stand out. Move away from the noise (TV, fan, street) or hold the phone a little closer.

saved.flash: Saved! It will be sent automatically.
saved.flashOffline: Saved on your phone. It will be sent when you are back online.
saved.lowSpace: Your phone is almost full. Free some space (photos, videos, apps) so your recordings can be kept until they are sent.

mic.permission-denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow microphone access for this app in your browser settings, then try again.
mic.no-mic: No microphone was found. Check your device, then try again.
mic.unsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Open the app in a recent Chrome or Safari.
mic.internal: Recording could not start. Close other apps that use the microphone, then try again.
mic.stopFailed: The take could not be finished: no sound reached the app. Check the microphone, then record again.
mic.prepare: Your take could not be prepared on this device. Try again, or update your browser.
mic.interrupted: The recording was interrupted (a call, another app, or the microphone was disconnected), so it was not kept. Please record it again.

goal.title: Session goal reached!
goal.body: {n, plural, one {# take recorded.} other {# takes recorded.}} Take a short break, drink some water, then carry on if you like.

done.title: All recorded!
done.body: You have recorded every mission available right now. Thank you! Your takes are checked by the team; you will see the results in your history.
done.sessionCount: {n, plural, one {# take} other {# takes}} this session

notReady.title: Not ready to record yet
notReady.body: Finish the steps on the campaign page first.

paused.title: Recording is paused
paused.body: The campaign is paused. Recording reopens when it resumes.

closed.title: Campaign ended
closed.body: This campaign no longer accepts recordings.

partner.title: Waiting for your partner
partner.body: Your conversation partner has not finished their consent yet.

testClosed.title: Your test is complete
testClosed.body: Everything was sent. The result arrives by email and shows on the test's page.
